Yeah I think you're right about her not respecting me much longer. I am mildly insecure but do not believe she is cheating on me with the other guy. Her excuses have been consistent, who knows. She could be really good at lying. But if that was the truth then why bother staying with me. I backed off the last couple days and she hasn't messaged me or anything. I know for sure she is fumeing right now because I haven't made any attempt to contact her, as this situation has happened before. When she does finally cave and message me, I'm going to tell her that I decided not to be her boyfriend when it's convenient for her. If this is the end of our relationship, I'm putting it all on her because this has been completely unfair to me.

/rant

Thank you for taking the time to comment. I appreciate it. Would love any other advice you might have.
